title: Register gate as an addressable item kind
description:
Declare `gate` as a registry-first `[item_kinds]` entry over `.jit/gates.toml` so every gate resolves at `@/gate/<key>`.

## Background

The project's item-kind engine already supports a project-scoped, registry-first kind sourced from a TOML array-of-tables — `[item_kinds.invariant]` is the shipped precedent (`.jit/config.toml:128-136`): `scope = "project"`, `source-of-truth = "registry-first"`, `source = { toml, table, id-field, text-field }`. An explicitly-declared `[item_kinds.X]` table must set all six fields of the kind six-tuple or config load fails (`config.rs:1523-1562` `validate_item_kinds`). `.jit/gates.toml` (built by the storage migration this depends on) holds gates as a `[[gates]]` array, each entry carrying a `key` and a `description` field, so `id-field = "key"`, `text-field = "description"` is a direct fit — the same mapping the story specifies ("gates resolve at `@/gate/<key>`").

`jit item show @/INV-02` is the existing precedent for resolving a project-scoped registry-first kind through the shipped binary (`item_cli_tests.rs:482-488`); gate addressing follows the same path but requires the explicit `gate` kind segment (gate keys are kebab-case slugs with no distinguishing id-pattern for inference, unlike `INV-NN`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `.jit/config.toml` declares `[item_kinds.gate]` with all six required fields: `scope = "project"`, `source-of-truth = "registry-first"`, `source = { toml = ".jit/gates.toml", table = "gates", id-field = "key", text-field = "description" }`, an id-pattern matching every shipped gate key (kebab-case slug, e.g. `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*` — matches cargo-ci, code-review, tests, clippy, fmt, jit-validate, plan-review, tdd-reminder, cargo-ci-features, repo-validate, coverage-preview, breakdown-review, npm-ci), and `link-namespaces = []` (a `Gate` has no outbound link field).
- [hard] REQ-02: `jit item show @/gate/<key> --json` resolves each configured gate (e.g. `@/gate/cargo-ci`) to an item whose text is that gate's `description`, for at least one gate exercised in a CLI or harness test.
- [hard] REQ-03: `jit item list --kind gate --json` lists every gate in `.jit/gates.toml` as an addressable item (mirrors the existing `jit item list --kind definition`/`--kind invariant` behavior for other project-scoped registry-first kinds).
